text.tspan: Sheet 1 HV power path and power stage
DC link 500 µF / 500 V · precharge 50 Ω · active discharge 50 Ω · bleeder 4 × 25 kΩ
PM1 IGBT six-pack 750 V / 820 A (antiparallel diodes integrated)
• Contactors, precharge relay and pack fuse are in the battery
junction box; coils driven from sheet 5.
• Phase current sensors are core-type Hall sensors around the
busbars: no galvanic connection, outputs on sheet 3.
• Gate and emitter connections of Q1…Q6: one driver channel
